label: EU-dsa-2022 Article 83

obligations.text: Before the adoption of any measures pursuant to the first paragraph of this Article, the Commission shall publish a draft thereof and invite all interested parties to submit their comments within the period set out therein, which shall not be less than one month.
Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the advisory procedure referred to in Article 88.
